selection_rule: On groups 0:16 only, select one global template using native was/is logits. Primary: maximize the minimum accuracy over the four A1 direction-by-side cells. A template is eligible only if every cell has at least 7/8 correct. Secondary: maximize the minimum cell mean signed correct-answer-minus-foil margin. Tertiary: fixed template order. registered_outcomes.pred_c_no_eligible_template: No template passes every FIT cell, so the holdout remains unopened and the dataset route stops.
